text:
Jamie (CEO): Quick heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT. Plan is ~45m: exec update on Q2 priorities, a short product demo (low-latency routing improvements), rollout callouts for Dedicated, a brief security policy note, and a 15-min open floor Q&A. Please drop 1–2 questions below or add them to the form. Recording will be posted after. calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/ah-1714321000

Elaine (People Ops): Invite sent to company, Slack reminder at 9:45am. Recording link posted to #all-hands within 1 hour after call :white_check_mark:

Devon (Product): Can we squeeze in the security policy change? It's small (3-4 slides) but affects Dedicated onboarding.

Jamie (CEO): Yes — adding a 5-min policy update. We'll keep the demo tight.

Anika (Eng-ML): Heads-up for demo: I'll show before/after latency p95 numbers and a short GIF of rollout behavior. Can engineering teams please surface any blockers now?

Mike (Eng-SRE): Noted. We have a post-deploy smoke test that sometimes flakes on region us-west-2 — won't block demo but worth calling out. We'll add an action to publish the runbook: /docs/runbooks/smoke-test.md

Sam (Marketing): We'll show one customer highlight (30s) at the end — helps PR. Can product confirm the quote?

calendar-bot: Event created by Elaine — "All-Hands: Exec update + Demo" Tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Jamie (CEO): Please submit your Qs by 6pm today so we can prioritize. If you see a question you want answered, react with :thumbsup: on the message.

Devon (Product): Q&A form: https://tiny.redwood/qna — drop a headline and optional follow-up.

Elaine (People Ops): Current RSVP: 118 attendees. We'll keep hybrid room setup and dial-in info in the invite.

Jamie (CEO) [post-call]: Recording uploaded: https://recordings.redwood.com/ah-1714321000. TL;DR highlights posted below:
- Exec priorities: focus on serving reliability, cost-per-token reduction, and simplifying Dedicated onboarding (new checklist).
- Product demo: routing improvements reduced median token latency by ~22% in internal benchmarks; KV cache hit improvements reduced cost on the demo workload.
- Policy: updated data retention guidance for Dedicated customers (preview doc: https://internal.redwood/policies/dedicated-data-retention). Short summary: default 90 days unless customer opts-in to extended retention; new KMS integration required for >90d.
- Rollout: canary starts next week for a subset of Dedicated hosts, automatic fallback enabled. Eng teams: watch canary dashboards and tag any anomalies with #canary-alert.
- Actions: Eng-SRE to publish smoke-test runbook by Friday; Product to confirm customer quote with Sam; People Ops will send out the meeting notes and slides.

Sam (Marketing): Thanks — will sync with Product on the quote and draft the customer highlight.

Mike (Eng-SRE): Action noted. I'll open the runbook PR and assign reviewers: @Anika, @Devon.

Anika (Eng-ML): Slides uploaded to the drive: https://drive.redwood.com/ah-slides/1714321000. Thanks for keeping the agenda tight.

Elaine (People Ops): Notes and link to recording will be pinned in #all-hands and sent in the daily digest. If you asked a question, check the summary — we answered the top 8 live and queued the rest for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

Jamie (CEO): Appreciate the quick prep everyone — short call, high signal. If anything in the recording needs a deeper follow-up, drop a note here or open a ticket in the relevant repo.

Sam (Marketing): :tada: great job, team!
